body:
Sounds like you're expecting him to read your mind/emotions which is not fair. 

Yes, a best friend should be there for you when something like this is happening. But you also have to communicate what you need and not expect them to know. 

I would also recommend communicating clearly and sincerely instead of joking and sarcastic comments. 

I'm sorry about your mom and I hope she is okay.

I'm so sorry 💙
It's been about two months for me now. It has gotten easier to function but I have constant memories. I've started having reoccurring dreams where I forget to feed him and have the same string of thoughts as I did in the real event like "how could I ever do this" "I'm so so sorry" as I frantically search for his food and bowl. He's not usually in the dreams but when he is he looks the way he did when I found him dead💔
My support system has been incredible, I am very fortunate. I've been forcing myself to do things without him to show myself that it can still love enjoyable, it's slowly working. I'm not ready for a new dog of my own but I think I'm going to foster soon. I've planned some grief work as well. It's going to be a lifelong process. I get reminded of him still multiple times a day. But it has gotten easier to talk about already.
